Exam Date & Time: 10-Aug-2022 (10:00 AM - 01:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. EXAMINATIONS (MIT MANIPAL) - AUGUST 2022  
  SUBJECT : MME 1051 - BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING  
  (MAKEUP)  
  BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING [MME 1051]  
Marks: 50                                                                            Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          Equal quantity of steam is supplied to a mixing chamber from two boilers through two  
  pipe connections. One boiler supplies steam which is 87% dry and the other boiler  
  supplies superheated steam at 325ºC. The steam pressure in both the boilers and in the (5)  
  mixing chamber is 15 bar. Determine the quality and temperature of the steam in the  
  mixing chamber. Assume the specific heat of superheated steam as 2.25kJ/kg K.  
  
1B)          Briefly explain the functions of the following:  
  a) Fusible Plug b) Steam Trap c) Economizer d) Feed Check Valve e) Air Preheater            (5)  
  
2A)          Determine the power transmitted from an open belt running over two pulleys 1.5m and  
  1.0m diameter that connects two parallel shafts 5m apart. The initial tension in the belt  
  when it is stationary is 3000N. The smaller pulley is rotating at 750 rpm and coefficient (4)  
  of friction between the belt and pulley is 0.25.  
  
2B)          There are 5 wheels having 20, 30, 40, 50 and 90 teeth with a diametrical pitch of 3 and  
  another set of 4 wheels of diametrical pitch of 2 having 20, 40, 60 and 80 teeth. Sketch  
  an arrangement to get maximum velocity ratio using maximum number of wheels from            (3)  
  the above lot. Calculate the velocity ratio and list the criteria to meet the above said  
  requirements.  
  
2C)          Differentiate a simple gear train from a compound gear train by listing 6 points each.  
  (3)  
  
3A)          From a test on a four stroke petrol engine, the following data is available: engine speed  
  2000 rpm, net brake torque 140 N-m, indicative mean effective pressure 2MPa, stroke  
  15 cm, bore 10 cm, rate of fuel consumption 10.28 kg/hr, CV of petrol 41000 kJ/kg.          (5)  
  Calculate the indicated thermal efficiency, brake thermal efficiency and mechanical  
  efficiency.  
  
3B)          With neat sketches and illustrating the pressure volume changes explain the working of  
  a 4 stroke diesel engine.                                                                   (5)  
  
4A)          Explain with a simple sketch, taper turning operation by swiveling the compound rest.  
  (4)  
  
4B)          Discuss the functions of the following parts of a Lathe machine.  
  i) Headstock  
  ii) Tailstock                                                                               (3)  
  iii) Bed  
  
4C)          Sketch and explain the principle of operation of a radial drilling machine.  
  (3)

5A)             Discuss the significance of the below listed properties of a moulding sand.  
  i) Permeability  
  ii) Adhesiveness                                                                  (4)  
  iii) Collapsibility  
  iv) Refractoriness  
  
5B)             Explain the following operations that can be carried out on a drilling machine:  
  i) Reaming  
  ii) Boring                                                                        (3)  
  iii) Spot facing  
  
5C)             Explain with a simple sketch, the working principle of resistance spot welding.  
  (3)  
  
  
-----End-----
